svg.title: P2p Icp Steps 1
svg.desc: Plot on x-y axes from minus 1 to 6, step 1 of point-to-point ICP: computing centroids. Blue point cloud P is a triangle with vertices at (1, 0), (2, 0) and (1.5, 2); its centroid p bar is at about (1.5, 0.67). Red point cloud Q is a triangle with vertices near (1.67, 4), (3.67, 4.5) and (3.67, 3.5); its centroid q bar is at (3, 4). Arrows from the origin point to each centroid.
